events.title: Live Music Friday
events.description: A four-piece jazz quartet takes the corner stage every Friday. No cover charge, dinner service runs as normal.

events.title: Wine Tasting: Southern Italy
events.description: Six pours from Puglia, Campania and Sicily, matched with small plates and led by our head sommelier.

events.title: Chef's Special Night
events.description: A seven-course tasting menu that never repeats, cooked and served by the kitchen team at the pass.

events.title: Holiday Dinner
events.description: A shared-table festive menu with mulled aperitif on arrival. Ideal for groups of six and above.

events.title: Pasta Masterclass
events.description: Two hours rolling, shaping and saucing with our pasta chef. You eat what you make, apron included.

events.title: Sunday Roast Sessions
events.description: Slow vinyl, long lunch, and a roast that lands on the table whole. Runs every Sunday through winter.

reviews.name: Amara Osei
reviews.text: Booked at 6pm for a table at 8pm and still got the window seat we asked for. The cod is the reason we keep coming back.

reviews.name: Daniel Whitfield
reviews.text: They noted the occasion on the booking form and brought out dessert with a candle. Nobody mentioned it, it just happened.

reviews.name: Priya Raghunathan
reviews.text: Large group, split bill, no fuss. The kitchen paced the courses so nobody was waiting on anyone else.

reviews.name: Tomás Ferreira
reviews.text: The sommelier talked us through six pours without a single word of jargon. We left with two bottles.

reviews.name: Hannah Lindqvist
reviews.text: In and out in fifty minutes with a proper plate of food. Rare for somewhere this good.

reviews.name: Marcus Oyelaran
reviews.text: Vegan menu that clearly had thought put into it rather than one sad pasta. The cauliflower steak was the best thing on the table.
